title: Tales of Mystery and Imagination Album Cover
coreRelationships: The central horizontal band of color acts as a focal point against the dark, expansive background.
The top and bottom text blocks are symmetrically balanced around the central band.
The abstract landscape within the band provides a contrast in color and form to the otherwise uniform background.
The dark background creates a sense of depth and mystery, enhancing the central illuminated landscape.
